record.question: What is the chemical formula of edible salt?
record.explanation: Answer D: NaCl. Edible table salt is sodium chloride. Its formula NaCl expresses the one-to-one ratio of sodium and chloride ions. Reference: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/Sodium-Chloride. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
